mapper.update: UPDATE user_picture_action a SET claimToken = #{claimToken}, claimedAt = #{claimedAt}, claimExpireAt = #{claimExpireAt}, attemptCount = attemptCount + 1 WHERE a.isProcessed = 0 AND a.isAccumulated = 0 AND (a.claimToken IS NULL OR a.claimExpireAt IS NULL OR a.claimExpireAt <= #{claimedAt}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM picture p WHERE p.id = a.pictureId AND p.isDelete = 0) ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT id, userId, pictureId, actionType, actionValue, source, eventId, createdTime, isProcessed, isAccumulated, claimToken, claimedAt, claimExpireAt, attemptCount FROM user_picture_action WHERE claimToken = #{claimToken} AND isAccumulated = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_picture_action SET isAccumulated = 1 WHERE claimToken = #{claimToken} AND isAccumulated = 0 AND id IN #{id}
UPDATE user_picture_action SET isProcessed = 1, claimToken = NULL, claimedAt = NULL, claimExpireAt = NULL WHERE claimToken = #{claimToken} AND isAccumulated = 1 AND isProcessed = 0
UPDATE user_picture_action SET isProcessed = 1, claimToken = NULL, claimedAt = NULL, claimExpireAt = NULL WHERE isProcessed = 0 AND isAccumulated = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN isProcessed = 0 AND isAccumulated = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN isProcessed = 0 AND isAccumulated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS accumulatedPendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN isProcessed = 0 AND claimToken IS NOT NULL AND claimExpireAt > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS claimedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN isProcessed = 0 AND attemptCount >= #{stuckThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS stuckCount FROM user_picture_action
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_picture_action a LEFT JOIN picture p ON p.id = a.pictureId AND p.isDelete = 0 WHERE a.isProcessed = 0 AND a.isAccumulated = 0 AND p.id IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_picture_action WHERE isProcessed = 1 AND createdTime < #{threshold}
